connection.bridges.offDetail: Tor connects to its network directly.

usage.page.off: Sharing is off. Nothing is sent.
usage.page.source: Read the source of the function that receives it
usage.page.offBody: The ID is deleted, and one last message says where it was turned off and how long Acira had been installed. It has no ID. Nothing is sent after that.
usage.page.marksTitle: What this computer keeps for the count
usage.page.marksFirst: A first message was sent: {answer}. A small yes or no kept in Acira’s data folder, so an update, a repair or a reinstall that keeps your data is never counted as a new install. It has no ID and goes with your data.
usage.page.marksBefore: Installed here before: {answer}. A second yes or no kept outside the data folder (on Windows a registry value that “Remove and delete my data” leaves; on a Mac a preferences value), so a wipe and a reinstall count as a returning install, not as a new person. No ID, no date, no version.

pwm.emptyBody: Click an email field on a site and choose “Use an email mask”.
